known_issues.title: Invoice page crashes on open
known_issues.workaround: Clear the browser cache or use the mobile app until 4.2.1 rolls out.

known_issues.title: Login loop after password reset
known_issues.workaround: Sign out on all devices, then sign in once from the web.

known_issues.title: Export to CSV times out over 10k rows

kb.title: Changing your plan
kb.answer: Go to Settings, Billing, Change plan. Changes apply from the next cycle.

kb.title: Support hours
kb.answer: Support is available 08:00 to 20:00 UK time, Monday to Friday.

kb.title: Exporting your data
kb.answer: Settings, Data, Export. Large exports arrive by email.

kb.title: Feature requests
kb.answer: Feature requests are logged from Settings, Feedback, and reviewed monthly.
